title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is rising. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 1 mph. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between the middle Lower Kula Road junction and Waiakoa, with no trade air on the lower west slope. The line is at Naalae Road or further south, where Kula is usually not flyable.
